steps.name: clients
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE Clients (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, contact TEXT);

steps.name: sites
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE Sites (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, client_id TEXT, name TEXT, address TEXT);

steps.name: assets
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE Assets (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, site_id TEXT, name TEXT, serial TEXT);

steps.name: tickets
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE Tickets (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, asset_id TEXT, issue TEXT, priority INT, closed BOOL, last_event TEXT);

steps.name: events
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE Events (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, ticket_id TEXT, kind TEXT, work_day TEXT, note TEXT, minutes INT, cost INT);

steps.name: sites_fk
steps.sql: ALTER TABLE Sites ADD FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES Clients(id);

steps.name: assets_fk
steps.sql: ALTER TABLE Assets ADD FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES Sites(id);

steps.name: tickets_fk
steps.sql: ALTER TABLE Tickets ADD FOREIGN KEY (asset_id) REFERENCES Assets(id);

steps.name: events_fk
steps.sql: ALTER TABLE Events ADD FOREIGN KEY (ticket_id) REFERENCES Tickets(id);
